reason: tests passed on baseline but fail after patch: tests.security.test_spawn_boundary.TestMechanicalBoundary::test_json_report_lists_reviewed_sites, tests.security.test_spawn_boundary.TestMechanicalBoundary::test_model_reachable_sites_are_explicitly_allowlisted, tests.security.test_spawn_boundary.TestMechanicalBoundary::test_verify_script_passes_on_current_tree
patch_summary: Guarded both --stream finalizers in vulnclaw/cli/main.py (run ~1467, solve ~1609): verified_claims from get_summary() is normalized via isinstance(claims, list) and degrades to [] for the int count (or None/missing), so enumerate(claims[:50]) never raises TypeError. List payloads keep the previous findings mapping; non-dict items still skipped. Added tests/cli/test_stream_verified_claims.py driving real run/solve --stream code with a genuine AgentState.get_summary() (count>0) via a loop-free coroutine trampoline (sandbox blocks event-loop sockets). Commits kept separate: 'test: add regression test' then 'fix: tolerate int verified_claims in --stream finalizers'.
root_cause: Type contract mismatch: AgentState.get_summary() returns verified_claims as an int count, but both --stream finalizers treated it as a list of claim dicts with (agent_state.get('verified_claims') or [])[:50]. Zero claims degraded via (0 or []) to []; any successful run (count>=1) raised TypeError: 'int' object is not subscriptable after evidence was written, skipping emit_complete_event and exiting 1.
